product_metadata.title: Twine Mint Melamine Cake Stand, Cupcake Stand, Home Decor, Food Service, Dessert Accessory, Mint Green, Set of 1
features: ENJOY THE BENEFITS OF MELAMINE - Melamine provides hardness, strength, water resistance, and moderate heat resistance. Plus it serves as a great backdrop for stunning desserts. There’s a reason melamine is so popular for food serving accessories!

MULTI-FUNCTION CAKE STAND FOR ALL SORTS OF EVENTS - Use as a cupcake stand, cake plate, fruit stand, fruit display, and other party accessories. This cake stand makes frosting and decorating cakes a breeze, and looks good doing it.

CLASSIC CAKESTAND STYLE IN BRIGHT COLORS - Create a functional centerpiece that looks great while also letting the dessert speak for itself. Easily fits on tables as a cake centerpiece, or at buffet serving tables. 11.5 inches in diameter, 8 inches tall.

EASY TO ASSEMBLE, CLEAN, AND STORE - Screws are included. Just attach the cake stand base to the cake plate and you’re ready to serve up wedding cakes, birthday cakes, and more! Quickly disassemble to clean thoroughly after use and store easily.

LIFE’S A PARTY - Give your dessert the presentation it deserves. Cakewalk crafts playful party accessories to bring some colorful flair to birthdays, weddings, housewarming parties, or any time cake is called for. Entertaining can be a cakewalk!
description: This cheerful cake stand is the perfect way to serve up any cake with some pizazz. Use for cakes, cupcakes, and any dessert that deserves top-notch presentation. Mint melamine 11.5 x 8 inches Durable construction Easy assembly
